messages:
maya: paging — got an SLO burn alert across eu-west, lots of small spikes, looks noisy. seeing multiple pages in the last hour. anyone oncall who can triage? :wave:
incbot: INCIDENT 2155432199: SLO_BURN_RATE_HIGH triggered for service=redwood-inference-api (severity=page). alert_ts=2155432199
liam: on it, pulling the burn windows now. quick ask — is this traffic pattern expected? any deploys?
deploybot: deploy: service=redwood-inference-api commit=6a3f2b3 started by @sophie at 2155431800 (completed)
sophie: I rolled a small config tweak 10m before the first page — changed batcher.max_wait_ms from 5->3 for a perf experiment. reverting now if that's the culprit.
arjun: logs show higher tail latency around 2155431500-2155432000, but token throughput steady. KV cache miss spikes correlate with those times.
maya: looks like short-lived cache miss storms cause brief burn-rate spikes in the 5m window and paging rule is too sensitive. can we avoid paging on short blips?
kim: agree. current alert rule pages on any burn_rate > 0.2 for 5m. we need multi-window logic: require both short and medium windows to be high, or require min sustained duration.
pat: for immediate mitigation: can we bump the alert "for:" to 15m or add a burn_floor to suppress pages for transient bursts?
liam: i can patch alerting to add a 15m floor for pages. do we want to keep a lower-severity slack-only alert for 5m burns so we still get visibility?
sophie: yes - slack-only for 5m, page only if 15m+ OR if 2 windows exceed threshold (5m and 60m). that keeps us aware but stops noisy pages.
ops-monitor: recommendation: add a short-term runbook step to check KV cache warming (endpoint /infra/kvcache/:service) when a 5m slack alert fires.
maya: actionable plan then: 1) change paging criteria 2) create new slo-burn dashboard with multi-window graphs 3) revert the experiment if it was a contributor. who owns each?
liam: i'll handle (1) — patch alertmanager rules and post the diff.
sophie: i'll revert the batcher tweak and watch for improvement.
arjun: i'll spin up a dashboard tab and add a heatmap for kv cache miss rate + burn windows (5m/30m/2h). sharing a temp link when ready.
pat: after mitigation, let's schedule a post-incident tune: consider adding a burn_floor metric and updating paging policy doc.
incbot: NOTE: Incident 2155432199 assigned to @liam (oncall) at 2155432230
liam: making the change now — updating alert rule. new rule draft:
```
alert: SLO_Burn_MultiWindow_Page
expr: (burn_rate(window=5m) > 0.2 and burn_rate(window=30m) > 0.12) or (burn_rate(window=15m) > 0.15)
for: 15m  # ensure sustained
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "Sustained SLO burn across windows for {{ $labels.service }}"
  runbook: "/runbooks/slo-burn-response"
```
liam: patch applied in staging; will promote to prod in 2min. posting PR: https://git.redwood/ops/alerts/pull/198
sophie: revert done, rolling back to batcher.max_wait_ms=5 at 2155432325. monitoring now.
arjun: temp dashboard: /dashboards/slo/slo-burn-2155432199 (private link) — added 5m/30m/2h burn curves + KV cache heatmap.
maya: after 10m of observation, pages stopped. root cause likely combination of experiment + cold KV shards. good catch.
kim: followups: - add burn_floor concept to alerting (suppress pages for single-window blips) - update paging docs to require at least 2 windows or 15m sustained - create alert that auto-triages short blips into a bezier-smoothed slack metric rather than paging
pat: i'll open a tracking ticket and schedule a tuning RFC with SRE + runtime next week. ticket: RW-ENG-4521
liam: pushed prod change at 2155432370, verified no new pages since. logging changes to opslog.
ops-monitor: note: changed paging criteria will not remove historical graphs. we should add a comparison panel to the SLO dashboard for "old vs new paging" behavior.
sophie: confirming backend latency dropped after revert and cache warming; KV misses normalized around 2155432500.
maya: closing the incident once RW-ENG-4521 is created and dashboard is linked in the ticket. thanks all. :heart:
pat: ticket created RW-ENG-4521: https://tickets.redwood/4521 — includes tasks: patch alerts, docs, dashboard, runbook updates, postmortem blameless notes.
liam: adding final runbook snippet to the ticket, gist for alert patch in PR description.
incbot: INCIDENT 2155432199: status=resolved, resolved_by=@liam, resolved_ts=2155432800
maya: marking this thread for post-incident review in next oncall sync.
